minor.issue: created_at is serialised as a naive ISO string ('2026-06-13T19:29:44.929000') with no timezone offset — Mongo strips tz on read and routes/activity.py calls .isoformat() on the naive value. Functionally fine (server stores UTC and treats inputs as naive UTC), but inconsistent with the activity_log.py docstring and surprising for any future consumer that does new Date(iso) in JS (browsers interpret no-offset as local time). Suggest .replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat() or appending 'Z'. ActivityRowItem.tsx already uses formatRelative() which compares against Date.now() — works because both sides drift the same direction, but tooltips via toLocaleString() will show the wrong wall-clock for non-UTC users.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/activity.py: created_at serialised as naive ISO string — see minor backend issue above.

/app/backend/routes/activity.py:_parse_iso accepts trailing 'Z' but the page.tsx isoDayStart/End helpers emit 'YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00' (no offset) — they round-trip fine against naive storage, but if the API is ever fixed to return offset-aware values the dayEnd helper at line 53 (`d.toISOString().slice(0,10) + 'T00:00:00'`) silently drops UTC and uses the local-calendar day, which can shift +/-1 day around midnight in non-UTC tz. Document or use UTC components consistently.

/app/frontend/src/app/dashboard/activity/page.tsx hasAnyFilter compares fromDate !== defaultFrom(): defaultFrom()/todayStr() are pure functions of `new Date()`, so the comparison is stable for the duration of a session but can return a stale 'has filter' once the day rolls over (the input still holds yesterday's string while defaultFrom() now returns today). Low-impact edge case — affects only the Clear-filters disabled state at midnight.

/app/frontend/src/app/dashboard/activity/page.tsx: useEffect at line 120 refetches on every baseParams change including action toggles — good UX (instant refilter) but each toggle issues a fresh ?limit=200 round-trip with no debounce. Acceptable today (admin-only, small payload), but if the catalog of action codes grows this should be debounced or behind an explicit 'Apply' button.

/app/frontend/src/components/activity/ActivityRowItem.tsx: ACTION_META duplicates the label table that the backend exposes via /api/activity/actions — fine for the icon mapping (frontend-only), but the labels can now drift. Consider having the row render `actionLabel(row.action)` fall back to the live /actions catalogue rather than the hardcoded copy.

/app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts activityApi.listGlobal uses paramsSerializer={indexes:null} which is the right axios incantation for repeated keys (verified against the backend's Query(List[str]) in routes/activity.py:87). LGTM.
